title: MOE Covalent Docking
description: Covalent docking of warhead-bearing compounds using MOE CovDock SVL with GBVI/WSA-dG rescoring.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

ligands.description: Warhead SMILES (.smi) or ligand SDF file.

reactive_residue.description: Target nucleophilic residue in format 'RESNAME:RESNUM' (e.g. CYS:145 for SARS-CoV-2 Mpro).

warhead_type.description: Electrophilic warhead chemotype. Acrylamide and chloroacetamide are the most clinically validated covalent warheads (ibrutinib, afatinib).
warhead_type.help_text: Acrylamide is reversible-covalent with soft thiols (CYS). Chloroacetamide is irreversible. Boronic acids target SER/THR (proteasome).

docking_protocol.description: Receptor flexibility during docking. Induced fit resamples side chains; rigid is faster.

n_poses.description: Number of docked poses to retain per ligand before rescoring.

top_n.description: Top poses to include in final SDF output after GBVI/WSA rescoring.

refine_poses.description: Apply GBVI/WSA-dG rescoring after initial CovDock placement. Improves pose ranking.

n_cpus.description: CPU cores for docking and rescoring.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
